title: Track Lead - Program & Project Management
description:
Track Lead \- Program \& Project Management
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


**Job Summary :** We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of network infrastructure projects. The role is primarily responsible for project planning, governance, schedule, budget, resources, risks, vendors, dependencies, and stakeholder communication. The Project Manager should have a sound knowledge and understanding of enterprise networking concepts to engage effectively with architects and engineering teams, challenge plans, identify delivery risks, and communicate technical impacts; hands\-on network configuration or engineering expertise is not required.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Job Responsibilities :** • Own the complete project lifecycle from initiation, planning, and execution through transition and closure. • Define and control project scope, objectives, deliverables, acceptance criteria, schedules, milestones, resource plans, and governance. • Develop and maintain project plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, change controls, decision logs, and status reports. • Manage project budgets, forecasts, procurement requirements, vendor deliverables, statements of work, invoices, and financial reporting. • Coordinate network architects, engineers, security teams, service providers, business teams, and operations stakeholders. • Monitor progress against agreed scope, cost, schedule, quality, and resource commitments; take corrective action when required. • Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, changes, and escalations. • Facilitate project meetings, governance reviews, steering committees, technical checkpoints, and executive updates. • Ensure network implementation plans cover testing, change approvals, maintenance windows, rollback, cutover, hypercare, and operational handover. • Translate technical updates into clear business impacts, decisions, risks, and actions for senior stakeholders. • Manage third\-party suppliers and ensure their deliverables, timelines, quality, and contractual commitments are achieved. • Ensure compliance with organizational project governance, security, change management, quality, audit, and documentation requirements. • Drive timely project closure, lessons learned, benefits tracking, and transition to business\-as\-usual support.


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


**Skill Requirement :** • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Management, or a related discipline. • 8\+ years of IT experience, including at least 4 years in project\-management roles. • Proven experience delivering medium\-to\-large infrastructure or network\-related projects across multiple teams and vendors. • Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling, budgeting, governance, risk management, change control, and stakeholder management. • Experience managing external vendors, contracts, procurement, technical dependencies, and distributed delivery teams. • Strong negotiation, facilitation, presentation, executive communication, and documentation skills. • PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or an equivalent project\-management certification is preferred. • ITIL certification and foundational networking or cloud certification are advantageous but not mandatory.


**Other Requirements**
----------------------


**Other Requirement :** • End\-to\-end project ownership and accountability • Project planning, governance, execution, and control • Stakeholder, vendor, and cross\-functional team management • Risk, issue, dependency, change, and escalation management • Budgeting, forecasting, and commercial awareness • Ability to understand and communicate network\-related impacts • Leadership, decision\-making, negotiation, and executive communication

title: SCT_Tech Enablement_AI Architect_Manager
description:
Location: Noida
Other locations: Anywhere in Country
Salary: Competitive
Date: Sep 17, 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1743788
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**



At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.



We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.



Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  


**About Global Delivery Services**



Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.



Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.



Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.



Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.



Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  


**The opportunity**



AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.


**Your key responsibilities**


* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.

  


**What we offer you**



At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.



Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: DU Head (DPO)
description:
DU Head (DPO)
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


**Principal / Distinguished Architect – Google Cloud AI, Agentspace \& Google AI Stack**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


### **Role Summary**


We are seeking a **very senior Google Cloud AI Architect** to lead the design, delivery, and governance of **enterprise\-scale AI and Generative AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** . This role requires deep hands\-on expertise across the **Google AI stack** , including **Vertex AI and Agentspace** , combined with strong customer\-facing leadership and the ability to **manage and mentor senior AI technical leaders embedded in customer environments** .


The role operates at the intersection of **AI platform strategy, cloud architecture, advanced GenAI engineering, and executive advisory** , acting as a trusted advisor to customer CXOs while scaling high\-performing AI architecture and engineering teams.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **1\. AI \& Cloud Architecture Leadership**


* Own **end\-to\-end architecture** for AI, GenAI, and data\-driven platforms built on **Google Cloud Platform** .
* Define **enterprise reference architectures, blueprints, and guardrails** aligned with Google Cloud best practices.
* Lead architecture decisions for **large\-scale, mission\-critical AI platforms** across multiple customer programs.
* Act as final escalation point for complex architecture, scalability, security, and cost challenges.

#### **2\. Generative AI, Gemini \& Agentspace**


* Architect and govern GenAI solutions using:
	+ **Vertex AI (Gemini models, Model Garden, Extensions)**
	+ **Google Agentspace** for building enterprise\-grade AI agents
	+ **Vertex AI Search \& Conversation**
* Design advanced GenAI patterns:
	+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
	+ Agentic workflows and multi\-agent orchestration
	+ Tool / function calling and enterprise system integration
* Define **Responsible AI, safety, and governance frameworks** aligned to Google AI principles.

#### **3\. Google AI \& Data Platform Architecture**


* Lead scalable AI and data platform architectures using:
	+ **BigQuery, BigLake, Cloud Storage**
	+ **Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub**
	+ **AlloyDB, Spanner (when applicable)**
* Architect **secure, multi\-project GCP environments** with strong network isolation and identity controls.
* Ensure high availability, resiliency, and performance for AI workloads.

#### **4\. MLOps, LLMOps \& Engineering Excellence**


* Define and enforce **MLOps / LLMOps standards** on GCP:
	+ Vertex AI Pipelines and CI/CD
	+ Model registry, versioning, and evaluation
	+ Prompt lifecycle management and experimentation
* Establish best practices for:
	+ Model quality, bias detection, and drift monitoring
	+ LLM evaluation and hallucination mitigation
	+ Cost governance and quota management

#### **5\. Security, Privacy \& Responsible AI**


* Architect secure AI systems with focus on:
	+ IAM, service accounts, workload identity federation
	+ VPC Service Controls, CMEK, data encryption
	+ Secure GenAI patterns (prompt injection prevention, data isolation)
* Ensure compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards (GDPR, SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, etc.).

#### **6\. Customer \& Executive Engagement**


* Act as **Chief / Principal AI Architect** for strategic customer engagements.
* Lead architecture and AI strategy discussions with **CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business leaders** .
* Translate complex business challenges into **scalable Google AI roadmaps** .
* Support pre\-sales and growth activities including:
	+ Technical solutioning and deal shaping
	+ Architecture due diligence and risk assessments
	+ RFP responses and solution defenses

#### **7\. People \& Technical Leadership**


* Lead and mentor **senior AI architects, principal engineers, and technical leaders** embedded within customer environments.
* Establish **architecture review boards and AI communities of practice** .
* Drive consistency of architecture, coding standards, and AI governance across accounts.
* Coach leaders on executive communication, technical depth, and customer advisory skills.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


### **Required Technical Expertise**


#### **Core Google Cloud Platform (Must\-Have)**


* **GCP Architecture (Expert Level)**
	+ Multi\-project design, shared VPCs, networking
	+ Identity \& security (IAM, IAP, VPC Service Controls)
	+ Google Cloud architecture and reliability best practices
* **Infrastructure as Code**
	+ Terraform, Deployment Manager

#### **AI / ML \& GenAI (Must\-Have)**


* **Vertex AI**
	+ Gemini models, custom model training
	+ Feature Store, Pipelines, Model Registry
* **Agentspace**
	+ Agent design, orchestration, and tool integration
* **Vector Search \& RAG**
	+ Vertex AI Vector Search
	+ BigQuery vector search

title: Fire Technician
description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced **Fire Fighting Technician** to join our team. The technician will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, testing, and repair of fire fighting systems, including sprinklers, fire pumps, hydrants, hose reels, and suppression systems in residential, commercial, and industrial facilities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Install fire fighting systems as per drawings and specifications.
* Maintain and repair fire pumps, piping networks, sprinkler heads, hose reels, fire extinguishers, and valves.
* Conduct routine inspections and testing of fire protection systems to ensure proper functionality and code compliance.
* Identify faults and troubleshoot fire fighting system issues efficiently.
* Work with supervisors and engineers to implement system upgrades or modifications.
* Ensure proper documentation of inspections, tests, and maintenance performed.
* Follow safety procedures and ensure compliance with local fire safety regulations.
* Coordinate with other MEP teams during project execution.

**Requirements:**

* Strong knowledge of fire pumps, sprinkler systems, hydrants, wet and dry risers, and other fire protection systems.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and system schematics.
* Familiarity with NFPA standards and local fire code regulations.
* Good problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Physically fit and able to work at heights or in confined spaces.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Fire Fighting Technician certification or vocational training.
* Experience in high\-rise buildings, hospitals, or industrial projects.
* Valid safety training certifications (e.g., Work at Heights, Confined Space Entry).

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Greater Noida): Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* fire technician: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person
